_comment: Arm-duration re-test (bidirectional_dshot_review.md's 2026-09-12 note under W18, decision/ADR-002-bidirectional-dshot.md's RX-design section): the original '500ms failed to arm, needed 3000ms' finding predates the mpremote-reset-corruption fix in scripts/deploy.py and may have been a stale-VM artifact rather than a real ESC timing requirement. This probe re-tests at 300ms - specification/DSHOT_PROTOCOL.md's generic 'typically 300ms for Bluejay' figure - on a freshly hard-reset board. Pass/fail signal is test_scenario_capture.py's own reply failsafe: if bidirectional channel 1 produces at least one non-all-zero eRPM reply within its 2s grace window after this arm phase, the ESC genuinely armed at this duration; a tripped failsafe (non-zero exit, outcome=failed in meta.txt) means it didn't. Run each of this file's siblings (_500, _1000, _3000) as fully separate scripts/deploy.py invocations - never back-to-back without deploy.py's own reset in between, or the same corruption this is re-testing for would contaminate the result.
